title: AI Agent Kit Manifest
description: Schema for ai-agent-kit manifest YAML files

kit_version.description: Kit version — used for migration checks

hosts.description: Runtime hosts the project supports. The kit renders one template tree per host into the target. opencode → .opencode/ tree + opencode.json. claude-code → .claude/ tree + .claude/settings.json + CLAUDE.md (main-session orchestrator). Multi-host installs render both side-by-side.

vault_path.description: Root path (relative to project) where KnowledgeOS stores all docs. Default: vault (matches KnowledgeOS out-of-the-box). Legacy: .vault

language_code.description: Agent output language (IETF language tag). Embedded into _shared.md so agents use the matching i18n locale. Supported: en (English), ru (Russian).

slice_caps.description: v6.0+ hard caps on plan/step size, enforced by @Main at CONFIRM and by @CodeWriter at EXECUTE. When exceeded, @Main asks PO to split before EXECUTE; @CodeWriter returns BLOCKED with reason OVERFLOW. Set any field to 0 to disable that cap.

max_steps.description: Max number of steps in plan.md § Implementation plan (v5 read this from feature.md § Implementation plan). 0 = no cap.

max_files_per_step.description: Max files (Create+Modify+Delete) a single @CodeWriter step may touch. 0 = no cap.

max_lines_per_step.description: Max total lines added+removed in a single @CodeWriter step (approx, from the agent's Changed Files table). 0 = no cap.

test_strategy.description: v6.0+ controls the order of test-vs-code writing in @CodeWriter. tdd_first (default, v5 behaviour): failing tests before production code. test_after: production code first, then tests against actual behaviour with @Reviewer Pass A4 enforcing assertion quality. mixed: tdd_first for AC-bound steps, test_after for exploratory/spike steps (CodeWriter picks per step). Two forms: (a) string for the project default; (b) object with {default, allow_per_step_override}.

allow_per_step_override.description: If true, individual steps in plan.md may declare `test_strategy: <mode>` to override the project default.

ci_host.description: v6.0+ marks the CI runtime so the kit can render a real CI workflow (P10). Currently supported: github (renders kit/.github/workflows/kit-gates.yml mirroring in-session lint/build/test gates). Required iff capability profile `ci-github` is in stack.profiles. Omit otherwise — the kit still works but real-CI gates are not deployed.

session_isolation.description: v6.1+ controls per-step clean-session automation. mode=per_step: @Main nudges PO toward /clear after every 5.6 CHECKPOINT (default; matches the vertical-slicing workflow). mode=per_milestone: nudge only before 5.7 RECONCILE and 5.10 diff-review. mode=overflow_only: nudge only on slice-cap overflow / replan / BLOCKED. prompt_style=silent: SessionStart hook injects context via additionalContext (Claude Code) / .planning/.session-bootstrap.md (OpenCode), no visible reminder. prompt_style=stderr: hook prints reminder to stderr before first PO input. prompt_style=both (default): silent injection + stderr reminder.

auto_commit_per_step.description: v6.1+ commits after each step's @Reviewer CLEAN (step 5.4b). Required for /kit-step-resume — clean-session-per-step relies on step_commits[] shas as anchor points. Set to false only if external commit policy conflicts; in that case /kit-step-resume falls back to last-known-state read without per-step revert capability.

allow_internal_steps.description: v6.1+ controls the runnable-slice gate at @Main step 3a. If false (default), every plan step must declare a user-visible Runnable: line; @Main BLOCKs PLAN if any step declares 'Runnable: internal — ...'. Set true for pure-backend modules with no UI surface where vertical slicing is impractical.

auto_approve.description: Controls whether @Main skips the CONFIRM step. Three forms: (a) boolean — same setting for all task classes; (b) object with per-class flags; (c) v6.0+ adds the diff_review key (mandatory PO eye on the full diff between EXECUTE and CLOSE — defaults to false even when other classes are auto-approved; this is the single-PO-eye gate that cannot be obscured by class-level autos). Other gates (DEPLOY, DESTROY, SECRET_ROTATE, MIGRATION, EXTERNAL_API) always require explicit PO approval — auto_approve does not affect them. Replaces the v4 AUTO_APPROVE=true magic string and @AutoApprover agent. Granular form added in v5.1; diff_review added in v6.0.

oneOf.description: Simple form: true = auto-approve all classes; false = always confirm.
Granular form: per-class booleans. Missing keys default to false.

feature.description: Auto-approve FEATURE pipeline CONFIRM (after PLAN, before EXECUTE).

bug.description: Per-severity auto-approve for /kit-fix BUG pipeline. Missing keys default to false. Severity is read from the Defects log entry; for free-form intake without an explicit severity, Status FAIL on a TC verifying a Critical EC = critical, otherwise medium.

diff_review.description: v6.0+ — auto-approve the diff-review gate between EXECUTE and CLOSE (P2). Default false even when feature/tech/bug are all true. Setting this to true bypasses the only mandatory PO-eye gate; do not enable lightly.

profiles.description: List of profile names to merge. Each profile declares an _profile_axis (language|framework|provider|capability). Cardinality rules: exactly one language profile, exactly one provider profile, zero or more framework profiles, zero or more capability profiles. Within a single axis, fields are exclusive (no overlap), so merge order within an axis is irrelevant; across axes, each axis owns disjoint fields. Manifest values still win over any merged profile value.

external_profiles.description: Map of profile name → source URL for profiles fetched from outside the kit repo via /kit-extend. Names here MUST also appear in stack.profiles. Used by /kit-update so external profiles can be re-validated without 404s on RAW_BASE/profiles/<axis>/<name>.yaml.

provider.description: OpenCode provider config. Required iff 'opencode' ∈ hosts. Ignored when only 'claude-code' is in hosts (Claude Code uses Anthropic native models via the Claude Code CLI/desktop).

models.description: OpenCode model role assignments (used as {{PROVIDER_ID}}/{{MODEL}} in opencode.json and agent frontmatter). Required iff 'opencode' ∈ hosts.

claude_code.description: Claude Code runtime config. Required iff 'claude-code' ∈ hosts. Models accept the Claude Code CLI aliases (opus | sonnet | haiku) or full model IDs (e.g. claude-opus-4-7, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5).

allOf.description: If opencode is in hosts, provider/models must be present.
If claude-code is in hosts, claude_code block must be present.
If capability profile ci-github is selected, ci_host must be set to github (v6.0+).
